Dear [Mr Riley](../persons.html#1239)
Have you Mr [H H Gibbs](../persons.html#558)’s name-?

He is either at St Dunstans, Regents Park or at Aldenham Elstree I should think no one would be more earnest in the cause than he. I would also mention the publisher - [A D Innes ](../persons.html#744)31 Bedford Street Strand.

Old Mr [Alexander Macmillan](../persons.html#939) I am sure would but I am not so sure of his sons though his partner Mr [G L Craik](../persons.html#379) would, I believe I am much obliged to [Mrs Riley](../persons.html#2121) for writing to me, I am sorry I was so stupid.

Of course you know Mr Gibbs’s name as MP for the City in the last Parliament and as a Bank Director[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Riley was probably trying to raise money for some charitable purpose.

[^2]: Henry Hucks Gibbs (1819-1907) was MP for the City of London 1891-2, which dates the letter.
